rows.Bloom: White. Mild, spice fragrance. 20 petals. Average diameter 4". Medium-large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season. Medium buds.
rows.Habit: Bushy. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Breeder's notes:
Long creamy buds of creamy white open to exquisitely fragrant flowers of pure white. Named in memory of Mrs Indira Prasad, a wonderful and rare human being, and founder member of the Hyderabad Rose Society ( as Viru and Girija too were and her husband Dr D L N Prasad, in 1978.

Prickles: small size, triangular, green
